concretechanges.before: The defense runs at approximately 300 milliseconds — state speed, not story speed. By the time you are aware of what you did, you have already done it. The defense is not chosen. It is executed.
concretechanges.after: A familiar defence may be underway before it is recognised. The map does not assign a universal latency or settle how much choice was available.

concretechanges.before: Not because you decided to withdraw — because the siege protocol activated and the drawbridge went up before the decision-making function loaded.
concretechanges.after: In the siege image, the drawbridge can feel as though it rose before a decision was made. That image invites examination of a particular withdrawal rather than explaining every person assigned Type 5.

concretechanges.before: Not generosity — a pre-emptive defense against abandonment.
concretechanges.after: Giving can sometimes become a defence against abandonment; the same act can also be generous. The account has to answer to the actual relationship.

concretechanges.before: The invoice is somatic before it is narrative. The body holds the running total of every defense that fired in situations that did not require it.
concretechanges.after: Bodily sensations may contribute to this inquiry, but they are not a balance sheet that can identify the history or type of a defence.

concretechanges.before:
Trigger. Defense. Cost.

Read the invoice. Not to feel bad about it. Not to add another layer of self-analysis. To stop paying a bill you never agreed to.
concretechanges.after: Read the invoice against a particular encounter: what happened, what response followed, and who bore its cost?

concretechanges.before: Seeing the invoice does not cancel the debt. But it stops you from accruing new charges at the old rate. And over time, that changes the balance sheet.
concretechanges.after: Seeing an invoice may still leave the next response unchanged. The balance sheet becomes useful when a later encounter shows what the reading helped you do differently.
